title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1973-11-11
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Professional v9.02 -> Cool Edit Pro v2.01 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) D

ai_review.summary: Pitch‑corrected soundboard captures a legendary Winterland show with a monster Dark Star, soaring Bertha > Greatest Story Ever Told and a haunting China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean, pitch‑corrected soundboard source that lets the band’s 1973 Winterland magic shine through. Reviewers rave about the first set’s brilliance and a second set anchored by an unforgettable Dark Star, Uncle John’s Band, and The Eyes of the World. Overall the performance is described as one of the era’s “sure‑thing” classics with crystal‑clear audio.

ai_rating.rationale: Over a dozen enthusiastic reviews (mostly 5‑star) praise both the musical performance and the excellent soundboard recording; only one outlier rating does not affect the overall high assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pitch‑corrected, crisp mix with clear instrument separation; reviewers call it an "Excellent soundboard" and note no dropouts or muddiness.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as gorgeous and high‑energy; second set builds a dark, atmospheric vibe highlighted by Dark Star and UJB, creating a seamless, compelling arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for melodic phrasing on Uncle John's Band and overall guitar leadership throughout the night.
band_member_comments.Phil: His solo that launches into the Dark Star jam is singled out as "wicked" and awe‑inspiring.
